section: Environmental Studies · Ch43 — Light — Deep Practice
subject: Environmental Studies
stem: A pencil dipped partly in a glass of water appears bent at the water's surface. This phenomenon is caused by:

options.option_text: Refraction of light as it passes from water to air
Reflection of light off the pencil
Diffraction of light around the glass

explanation: Light bends (refracts) when passing between media of different optical densities, making the submerged part appear bent at the surface.

section: Environmental Studies · Ch43 — Light — Deep Practice
subject: Environmental Studies
stem: A rainbow forms in the sky when sunlight passes through raindrops and splits into its seven constituent colours. This splitting of white light is called:
explanation: Dispersion is the splitting of white light into its spectrum of colours (VIBGYOR) as different wavelengths refract by different amounts.
